# Consensus-sensitive paths for the DevNet gate (.github/workflows/devnet.yml).
#
# One POSIX extended regular expression per line, matched against
# repository-relative paths of the files a pull request changes. Blank lines and
# lines starting with "#" are ignored. When any changed path matches any pattern,
# the pull request runs both DevNet suites (all-Dingo and --conformance).
#
# Patterns are consumed by two things, so keep them valid in both:
#   - grep -E in .github/scripts/devnet-path-filter.sh
#   - Go regexp in internal/test/ci/devnet_path_filter_test.go, which fails when
#     a pattern matches nothing in the tree. A filter that matches nothing is
#     worse than no filter, because it looks like coverage.

# Chain storage, chain growth, and chain selection
^chain/
^chainselection/
^chainsync/
^consensus/

# Ledger: block/header validation, VRF/KES/OpCert checks, epoch and nonce
# logic, forging, leader election, rewards, governance
^ledger/
^ledgerstate/

# Mempool and transaction admission
^mempool/

# Ouroboros mini-protocol handlers: NtN (chainsync, blockfetch, txsubmission,
# keepalive, peersharing) and NtC (localstatequery, localtxsubmission,
# localtxmonitor)
^ouroboros/

# Peer connectivity for the DevNet ring topology
^connmanager/
^peergov/
^topology/

# Block-producer credentials (VRF/KES key files, KES evolution)
^keystore/

# Cross-component event bus carrying block/chain/mempool/peer events
^event/

# Chain and ledger storage backing every node in the network
^database/
^plugin/

# Node composition, forging wiring, and configuration surface
^node[^/]*\.go$
^config\.go$
^internal/node/
^internal/config/
^internal/leiosheader/
^cmd/dingo/

# Network configuration and genesis shipped for devnet runs
^config/cardano/

# DevNet infrastructure and the container images it builds
^internal/test/devnet/
^internal/test/antithesis/
^Dockerfile$
^Makefile$

# The gate itself, its path filter, and the test that guards the filter
^\.github/workflows/devnet\.yml$
^\.github/workflows/devnet-suite\.yml$
^\.github/devnet-paths\.txt$
^\.github/scripts/devnet-path-filter\.sh$
^internal/test/ci/

# Shared dependencies (gouroboros, plutigo, and everything else pinned here)
^go\.mod$
^go\.sum$
